tacticalIdentity: Repetition and echo specialist. Copies the last spell cast (by any Mancer) and fires a delayed echo at 60% power. Excels by amplifying high-value ally casts. Afterimage creates positional decoys. Echo is the core identity — it extends the reach of any allied spell at reduced cost.
designNotes: Weakest isolated; strongest as a force-multiplier. Echo at 60% power of Pillar of Flame = 33 AoE damage from 2 AP. Phase Step repositions without spending movement AP.

baseSpells.description: A quick arcane projectile dealing 10 damage. The most efficient direct-damage option in the kit — used as a filler when Echo is on cooldown.
baseSpells.designNotes: 1 AP direct damage filler. No cooldown.

baseSpells.description: Projects a convincing illusory copy of the Echomancer at a target tile. The Afterimage persists 2 turns; enemies who target it waste their attack. Afterimage collapses on first hit, dealing 5 arcane damage to the attacker.
baseSpells.designNotes: 1 AP decoy placement. Baits enemy targeting. Up to 2 active Afterimages. Collapse deals 5 damage to attacker.

baseSpells.description: Fires a delayed echo of the last spell cast by any allied Mancer this turn, at the same target or nearest valid target. Deals 60% of the echoed spell's base damage and applies status effects at 60% of their original duration (rounded down). Cannot echo healing effects.
baseSpells.designNotes: Core identity spell. Echoes inherit the element and temperatureDelta of the echoed spell at 60% intensity. Timing is everything — echo a Pillar of Flame for 33 AoE damage.

baseSpells.description: The Echomancer phases through the arcane plane, teleporting up to 5 tiles without using movement AP. Leaves an Afterimage at the departure point for 1 turn.
baseSpells.designNotes: Repositioning without movement AP cost. Leaves Afterimage for distraction. Key escape tool for a low-HP Mancer.

baseSpells.description: Imprints the Echomancer's echo-weave onto an ally, marking their next action for automatic repetition. The ally's next spell or attack resolves normally, then at end of the resolution phase, an echo of that same action repeats at 50% effectiveness (half damage, half duration on statuses, rounded down). Healing cannot be echoed. Imprint expires unused at end of the following turn.
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Delayed free double-strike at 50% power. On Chronomancer Timestep target: original action + Timestep action + Phantom echo = three hits from one unit.
